subject: MSA addendum playbook and legal queue coordination
messages:
From: Anna Keller <anna.keller@lumenhealth.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal request + MSA addendum (term and capacity changes)

Connor —

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. We reviewed usage and would like to move forward with a renewal that includes: a move from a 12-month to 24-month term, a 2x capacity uplift (expected burst patterns during Q1), and a signed addendum to reflect the term change and updated order form.

Attached is our internal redline (Lumen_Redo_Redlines.pdf) — highlights:
- Section 4.2 (Term): request 24 months with a 60-day early-termination clause tied to M&A.
- Exhibit B: capacity ramps and a quarterly true-up.
- Data retention paragraph: clarify that logs retained for 24 months for audit.

We'd like to aim for counters by next week if possible; do you have a legal contact at Redwood who will consolidate? Also include any price deck for the uplift so procurement can budget.

Appreciate it —
Anna Keller
Head of Platform Integrations
Lumen Health
Attachment: Lumen_Redo_Redlines.pdf (PDF)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Anna Keller <anna.keller@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal request + MSA addendum (term and capacity changes)

Thanks Anna — this is helpful. We're excited to continue working with Lumen. High level next steps from our side:

1) I'll coordinate an internal rapid review (legal + sales ops) and return consolidated comments within 3 business days.
2) Marissa (cc'd) will confirm pricing for the 2x uplift and provide an updated order form.
3) If the 24-month term is acceptable, we'll prepare an addendum to the MSA and an amended order form reflecting the quarterly true-up approach.

For transparency, I'll run this through our standard renewal playbook: attach the checklist so you know the queue.

Deliverables we plan to send: consolidated redline (PDF), an updated order form (XLSX), and a proposed execution timeline (Doc). If procurement needs a formal pricing sheet we can include that as well.

Can you confirm the proposed start date for the renewed term (e.g., 2027-01-01) and the contact on procurement?

Connor O'Brien
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachment: Redwood_Renewal_Checklist_v1.docx (DOCX)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 08:58:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Renewal request + MSA addendum — internal kickoff and plays

Team — forwarding Lumen's redlines. Quick plan and asks:

- Marissa: confirm list price for 2x capacity uplift and whether we can offer a 6% retention discount for a 24-month commit in this region. Also confirm PO vs SOW acceptance.
- Naomi (CS): confirm that the proposed quarterly true-up and 24-month log retention align with our SLI/retention policies; flag any support/implementation work.
- Ben (Sales Ops): please create/update the HubSpot deal (DL-47821) and attach Lumen's redline; set stage to "Legal Review" and add deadline Nov 30 for legal counter.

Legal coordination note: we'll ask Legal to produce a consolidated MSA addendum with inline comments. I want the first Redwood consolidated comments back no later than EOD Nov 30 so we can circulate to Lumen on Dec 1. If you foresee breaks on the SLA credit language, call it out now.

Attachments: internal_summary.pdf (one-pager with impact estimate)

Connor

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 11:14:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal request + MSA addendum — internal kickoff and plays

Connor —

Quick answers:
- Pricing: I can confirm list pricing and an internal approval for a 6% term discount contingent on standard SLA language. I'll push pricing sheet by EOD Nov 27. (See HubSpot deal link: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/47821)
- On SLA: we should avoid open-ended credit exposure. Propose using our standard SLA matrix with a 6-figure cap for the first 12 months then a pro-rated reduction; I'll flag specifics in the redline excerpt.
- Procurement: Lumen prefers PO routing; we will support PO acceptance but include standard PO terms in the order form.

Attached: MSA_redline_accepted_snippets.txt — includes the three passages we can accept with minor edits. Naomi, please confirm the retention request (24 months) is OK operationally.

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Enterprise Renewals
Redwood Inference
